references.text: The Lord's promise to Joshua to be with him, just as He was with Moses, is fulfilled here.
God's promise to be with Joshua wherever he goes is confirmed through his growing reputation.
The Lord promised to exalt Joshua in the eyes of all Israel, which now happens through his fame.
After crossing the Jordan, the Lord exalted Joshua, and this exaltation continues here.
God's promise to be with Moses is now repeated with Joshua as his successor.
David experienced similar divine presence: 'The Lord was with him wherever he went.'
Solomon's reputation spread in a similar way to all lands because of the Lord's blessing.
As with Joseph, the Lord was with Joshua and gave him success in everything he did.
